text:
Deploy Bot: Deploy v2.14.8 -> prod finished on canary (10% traffic). Auto-promote scheduled in 10m unless issues are raised.
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p95 and p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate across prod canaries; increased timeouts and 502/504s. Error rate crossed alert threshold 0.9%.
Ravi (oncall): I'm looking. seeing p95 jump from 180ms -> 2.1s and p99 to 8s on canary pods. Paging SRE.
Andrea (runtime): grabbing runtime logs and qps heatmap. I suspect KV cache churn after the new model variant landed — cold cache + bigger kvs = longer decode stalls.
Liam (sre): can you paste the top stack traces or gateway logs?
Andrea (runtime): logs (snips):
```
[2026-11-05T12:41:23Z] upstream request timeout: context deadline exceeded
handler: llm-inference -> kv-cache miss, backend decode waiting 6.8s
trace_id=abc123 host=prod-gen-canary-3
```
Ravi (oncall): Confirmed 504s at the gateway. Throughput steady. CPU/GPU utilization on canary pods normal but tail latencies high.
Andrea (runtime): Looks like the new checkpoint increases kv cache size and also altered attention-memory layout; kernel selection mismatch for some sequences causing stalls. Quick mitigation: rollback canary promotion and route traffic back to previous model, or enable degraded small-context path.
Ravi (oncall): Can we quick rollback the canary promotion? We haven't promoted to 100% yet but canary is already 10% and causing customer errors.
Deploy Bot: Rollback command available: `/deploy rollback v2.14.8 --to v2.14.7 --scope canary`
Ravi (oncall): Running rollback now.
Andrea (runtime): While rollback runs, enable fallback policy that forces older encoder path: `--model-compatibility=legacy` on ingress. That will reduce feature set but avoid kv cache path.
Liam (sre): I can flip the routing rule. Doing `kubectl patch` to route canary traffic to v2.14.7 instances and update service selectors.
Ravi (oncall): Executed rollback CLI: `deploy rollback --id v2.14.8 --target v2.14.7` -> Deploy Bot confirms.
Deploy Bot: Rollback started. Canary pods terminating, v2.14.7 replicas scaling up. Estimated 60s to re-stabilize.
Oncall Bot: Monitoring: p95 decreasing. p99 trending down. Error rate begin to drop.
Sofia (cs): Any known customers impacted? Need to triage externally.
Ravi (oncall): Early telemetry shows spike in errors for a handful of high-throughput customers using streaming and long context windows. Not many unique customers but heavy sessions saw degraded responses.
Sofia (cs): I'll draft a proactive message to affected accounts and set expectation: performance blip -> rollback -> monitoring.
Andrea (runtime): Post-rollback logs show kernel fallback worked, and kv cache warmup caused a transient bump but not the 8s stalls. Root cause hypothesis: model variant changed kv shape + runtime kernel selector bug for certain sequence alignment -> catastrophic stall for some sequences.
Liam (sre): After rollback, I see p95 back to ~220ms and p99 ~400ms. 5xxs dropped from 1.2% -> 0.08% in 4m.
Ravi (oncall): Good. Opening incident ticket and will mark severity P2 until we validate no remaining customer impact.
Ravi (oncall): Incident ticket: RID-2026-3056 created, linking logs and rollback timeline.
Sofia (cs): Noted. Sending email to 3 customers now. CC'ing product & legal for visibility.
Andrea (runtime): Next steps for eng: reproduce kernel selection mismatch locally, add canary-only slow-path guard, and add unit test for kv-shape detection. Also propose we add an automatic canary traffic limiter that pauses promotion if p99 > 2s for 3 consecutive minutes.
Liam (sre): I'll follow up with instrumentation changes: add per-kernel latency histograms and early aborts for stalls > 2s.
Ravi (oncall): Handoff: my shift ends in 30m. Liam, please own the post-rollback validation and the incident doc (timeline, RCA TODOs). Andrea please own the fix and the canary guard. Sofia to handle customer comms and comp plan if needed.
Liam (sre): Got it. I'll run end-to-end synthetic tests (long-context streaming) and monitor for 1h. If anything resurges, I'll alert and escalate.
Andrea (runtime): I'll spin up a repro with the v2.14.8 artifact and instrument kv cache ops. ETA 3h for a reliable repro.
Ravi (oncall): Thanks. Closing active pager for now. Leaving the thread open for follow-ups and RCA. :white_check_mark:
Oncall Bot: Pager cleared. Handoff recorded to Liam (sre).
Sofia (cs): Customer messages sent. I'll update once I hear responses.
Liam (sre): Adding a short postmortem stub in the incident tracker and will expand after Andrea shares root cause.
Andrea (runtime): Also adding a note: avoid automatic full promotion of models that significantly change KV footprint without a longer canary run.
Ravi (oncall): End of live mitigation. Followups: RCA, canary guard, kernel unit tests, customer outreach summary.
Sofia (cs): I'll prepare a short post-incident summary for CSMs and affected customers.
Ravi (oncall): Thanks team. If anything else crops up, ping here.
